name: Plato Protagoras
source:
Socrates retells his conversation with the great Sophist Protagoras at the house of Callias concerning whether virtue can be taught.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gutenberg.org/files/1591/1591-h/1591-h.htm#link2H_INTR]eBook's Introduction section[/url]]
translation:
苏格拉底重述了他在卡利亚斯家里与伟大的智者普罗泰戈拉关于美德能否被传授的谈话。
